notes: Update since 3.11.27 (v3.11.28-3.11.30). The vertical velocity is now integrated from the unfiltered acceleration instead of the median-filtered one: the median erased the short impulse of a bar hitting the floor, so after a deadlift landing the velocity stayed away from zero and the drift correction then spread that error over the whole set; with the unfiltered signal it returns to zero after every landing, and in offline replays of squat captures reps that the old filter missed are now reported. The default stillness windows are shorter (velocity and acceleration flat windows 30 to 20 samples, above-ceiling window 45 to 30). The raw serial debug log gains four columns (worldAccZRaw, gyroRawX, gyroRawY, gyroRawZ). No BLE protocol change: the Config characteristic stays 38 bytes, so any app 1.0.0+3 or newer keeps working. Companion app 1.0.1 is recommended: its settings screen no longer shows the drift-correction parameters and uses the new default windows.
